name: Google Pixel

charge_control.note: Google charger driver (Pixel 6 and later): charging stops at or above this level, so a value below the current charge stops it and 100 restores normal charging. USB keeps powering the phone.
Same driver on Snapdragon Pixels (Pixel 4 and 5). Uncertain for older Pixels: verify.
Older Snapdragon Pixels (Pixel 2 and 3 era). Uncertain: verify.
Snapdragon Pixels: suspends USB input, so the phone runs from the battery while charging is stopped.

autoboot.note: After unlocking the bootloader: adb reboot bootloader; fastboot oem off-mode-charge 0; fastboot reboot (or tools/phase0/phase0.sh autoboot --fastboot). Prove it with tools/phase0/phase0.sh autoboot --test.

notes: Matches every Google phone whose model starts with 'Pixel'. Generations differ: run Phase 0 on the exact model and narrow this profile (or add a model-specific one) once the charge path is proven.
current_now sign and unit differ between Pixel generations: measure with tools/phase0/phase0.sh current-sign before relying on the net-current alert.
USB tethering may use ncm instead of rndis on newer Pixels and Android versions: tools/phase0/phase0.sh usb shows the interface (rndis0 or ncm0). Set usb_function to match.
Recent Pixels offer a built-in 80% charging limit (Settings, Battery, Charging optimization; availability depends on model and Android version), a useful base layer under the Agent's lower limit.
